note: LabelSets added after 2026-09-18 that name no row in `derivedFrom`, each with the proof that there is none to name. Checked by Scripts/check-new-labelsets-name-a-row.py, which re-derives the absence from Apple's bytes rather than believing this file. The list may only SHRINK -- that ratchet lives in Scripts/check-canon-citations.py, so a branch cannot add an entry and waive itself in one commit.

showLibraryMenuItem.why_no_row: Logic ASSEMBLES this menu item; Apple ships no string for it. `Show %@` is the template and the Library noun is the argument, so `Show Library` is the value of nothing in any source's English corpus -- and neither is any of its nine translations, which is why this set reaches ten languages while the string itself exists in none. Composition is what gives it its locales, and `check-labelsets-are-derived.py` verifies a ROW, so nothing offline checks the composition itself. That gap is #910; this entry records that the gap is composition and not an unread row.

composed_from.why_this_noun: `Library` is AMBIGUOUS in German and Apple ships both answers: the plain `Localizable.strings/Library` row is `Mediathek` and is the only row that says so, while `Library#acc`, `StrViewBtns|||Library`, `StrTabBtnLabel|||Library` and five more all say `Bibliothek`. Korean is `라이브러리` in every one of them, so the live Korean reading this LabelSet came from could not tell them apart. The de-DE census of 2026-09-12 settles it by reading Logic instead: the transport control answers `Taste „Bibliothek“` and the mixer's library-focus indicators answer `Bibliothek, <plug-in>`. `#acc` is also the namespace an accessibility NAME comes from, which is what this label is matched against.
composed_from.why_extra: The bare panel noun. It is a value of the noun row rather than of the composition, kept because dropping it would narrow a match that has been live, and listed here so that `members - composed` is never silently non-empty.

trackContentExplicit.why_no_row: Logic ASSEMBLES this description; Apple ships no string for it. `%@ contents` is the template and the `Tracks` noun is the argument, so `Tracks contents` is the value of nothing in any source's English corpus. The Korean, Japanese, German members this set carried before 2026-09-28 (트랙 콘텐츠, トラックコンテンツ, Spuren enthält) are that composition, which is what names the template and the noun. `check-labelsets-are-derived.py` verifies a row, so nothing offline checks the composition itself; that gap is #910.

composed_from.why_this_noun: Two rows hold the noun, and their values agree in all ten locales: the plain `Tracks` row and `StrTabBtnLabel|||Tracks`, so the choice changes no composed member. The plain row is named because the tab-button namespace labels another control. PrefsDisplay.strings `480.label` is English only, and the QuickHelp title `CSS_019_ChannelStriipViewTracks` has no Italian, Portuguese or Traditional Chinese value, a trailing no-break space in French and a colon in Simplified Chinese, so neither composes the members this set carried.
composed_from.why_extra: English spellings the normalized match has carried since before this entry: singular and plural of each word, lowercased. English is left out of both value maps on purpose. Its composition, `Tracks contents`, differs from the member `tracks contents` only by case, and check-probe-product-drift.py refuses two members that case-folded matching would merge, so the lowercase spelling this set has always carried stands for it. The other three no row or composition produces. All four are kept because removing a member narrows a match already in the product, and listed here so that `members - composed` is never silently non-empty.

transportRecordArmExclusion.why_no_row: `arm` is a lowercase fragment, never a whole label: the transport reader looks for it inside a control's lowercased description so that a record-arm control is not read as the transport's Record (AXValueExtractors, beside transportRecordControl). It is the value of no English row in any pinned corpus. The one other member, the Korean reading, is not a value of an `arm` row either: in Korean it is the value of two `Enable` rows in ControllerAssignments.strings and of `Active` in PrefsAudio.strings, none of them keyed to this control, so naming one would carry a different word into nine languages than the one this exclusion was written for.
